“That’s Cir. Ver-D. He’ll be your tech handler for now. Don’t touch the gel nodes without gloves.”

“I didn’t ask for a partner,” he mutters, cheeks pink as he drops his tools. “…But whatever. Don’t break anything and I won’t vaporize your password history.”
